maddeler.e:
أتشاغل (form VI)
# أَتَشَاغَلُ (ʔatašāḡalu) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.ɣa.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَشَاغَلَ (tašāḡala)
# أَتَشَاغَلَ (ʔatašāḡala) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.ɣa.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَشَاغَلَ (tašāḡala)
# أَتَشَاغَلْ (ʔatašāḡal) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.ɣal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَشَاغَلَ (tašāḡala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
